title: Adapting the Interface, Not the Model: Runtime Harness Adaptation for Deterministic LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.22166v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents are shaped not only by their language models, but also by the runtime harness that mediates observation, tool use, action execution, feedback interpretation, and trajectory control. While existing agent adaptation methods mainly update model parameters, many failures in deterministic, rule-governed domains stem from mismatches at the model--environment interface. We propose Life-Harness, a lifecycle-aware runtime harness that improves frozen LLM agents without changing model weights or evaluation environments. translated_title: 适配接口而非模型：面向确定性LLM智能体的运行时框架适配
translated_abstract: LLM智能体不仅由其语言模型塑造，还由其中介观察、工具使用、动作执行、反馈解释和轨迹控制的运行时框架塑造。现有的智能体适应方法主要集中于更新模型参数，然而在确定性、规则约束的领域中，许多失败源于模型与环境接口之间的不匹配。我们提出了Life-Harness，一个生命周期感知的运行时框架，能够在不改变模型权重或评估环境的前提下改进冻结的LLM智能体。Life-Harness从训练轨迹中演化而来，将反复出现的交互失败转化为可复用的干预措施，涵盖环境契约、程序性技能、动作实现和轨迹调节四个层面，并在评估未见任务时保持固定。我们在AgentBench、$\tau$-bench、$\tau^2$-bench和AppWorld的八个环境中，使用18个开源权重的骨干模型对Life-Harness进行了评估。
tldr: 提出Life-Harness生命周期感知运行时框架，通过将训练轨迹中的交互失败转化为接口层面的可复用干预措施，在不改变模型权重和评估环境的情况下提升冻结LLM智能体在确定性任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: Life-Harness is a lifecycle-aware runtime harness that improves frozen LLM agents by converting recurring interaction failures from training trajectories into reusable interface-level interventions, without changing model weights or evaluation environments.
